span.p: Start or resume the existing campaign

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Acquire nonblocking supervisor lock
One owner per user home

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Validate saved identity, configuration and run manifest
Keep original start and cutoff
Default duration: 12 hours; configurable

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Check saved PID identity before recovery
Reap owned orphan group; close interrupted repair
Replay audit outbox; retain original incident

div.style: color: rgb(89, 53, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Reject unsafe startup
Do not claim another owner's process
Preserve existing campaign evidence

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Persisted blocked phase
or repair-account quota block?

div.style: color: rgb(89, 53, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Exit 2 with campaign state preserved
Existing owner requires explicit reconciliation
Restart alone does not clear the blocker

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Original cutoff reached
or stop requested?

div.style: color: rgb(89, 53, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Stop and reap owned child processes
Preserve world, checkpoint and original cutoff

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Pending action and source revision
missing or changed?

div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Capture reconciliation incident
Do not launch gameplay against changed source

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Record source revision and segment
Durably persist child-launch audit transition
Audit failure stops further launches

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Resume FLE hierarchical controller
Same checkpoint and session; remaining time only
Hybrid policy; Jev 1.13.0; configured features

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Monitor checkpoint, owned process and fresh health
Default polling interval: 5 seconds

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Fresh matching health shows provider,
storage or maintenance hold,
or an owned pending/background job?

div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Refresh watchdog baseline
Keep observing without invoking source repair
A heartbeat alone is not useful progress

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Checkpoint unchanged beyond hang threshold?
Default: 600 seconds

div.style: color: rgb(46, 72, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Controller checkpoint reports completed
Stop owned gameplay process
Supervisor records campaign completion

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p: Time remains and no stop request?

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Stop and reap owned gameplay process
Classify latest checkpoint and matching exit evidence
